# Wavelet and Transform-based Compression

Also called: Transform-based Volume Compression, Frequency Domain Compression

## Overview
Wavelet and Transform-based Compression reduces volumetric data size by projecting the signal into a frequency or residual domain where energy is compacted, allowing for efficient quantization and entropy coding [G]. It solves the problem of high memory bandwidth and storage requirements for large 3D datasets by exploiting spatial correlation and smoothness [G]. What sets it apart from [Value compression](6-value-compression.md), which operates directly on amplitude statistics, and [Sparse structures](5-sparse-structures.md), which address geometric sparsity, is its reliance on linear basis functions (wavelets, pyramids) to decorrelate data, enabling multi-resolution access and superior handling of smooth gradients [G].

## Shared principles
All methods in this family share the mechanism of decomposing the input volume $V$ into a set of coefficients $C$ using a linear transform, followed by encoding and optional decoding for rendering [Value compression](6-value-compression.md).

1. **Transform:** The volume is decomposed using a separable 1D filter bank applied along each axis [Wavelet and Pyramid Transforms](3856-wavelet-and-pyramid-transforms.md). For a 3D volume, this results in subbands representing different frequency components [G]. In wavelet transforms, these are typically approximation (low-pass) and detail (high-pass) coefficients [G]. In Laplacian pyramids, they are detail residuals between levels of a Gaussian pyramid [Wavelet and Pyramid Transforms](3856-wavelet-and-pyramid-transforms.md).
2. **Hierarchy:** The decomposition is recursive [Value compression](6-value-compression.md). The approximation subband from level $j$ is further decomposed at level $j+1$, creating a tree-like structure of coefficients [Value compression](6-value-compression.md). This allows for multi-resolution access, where coarse data is available at the root and fine details are deeper in the tree [Value compression](6-value-compression.md).
3. **Quantization and Entropy Encoding:** Coefficients are quantized (lossy) or kept precise (lossless) [G]. Entropy coding (e.g., Huffman, Arithmetic, Run-Length) is applied to the quantized or raw coefficients to produce the compressed bitstream [Value compression](6-value-compression.md).
4. **Reconstruction:** To render, the necessary coefficients are decoded and the inverse transform is applied [G]. This can be done globally (full reconstruction) or locally (block-wise or point-wise) to support adaptive resolution rendering [Value compression](6-value-compression.md).

## Subtopics

### [Value compression](6-value-compression.md)
Reduces storage by encoding voxel values directly, distinct from spatial compression. It manipulates the amplitude domain to minimize bit-depth. Sets it apart from global transform methods by relying on fixed-size, data-independent blocks or local statistical properties, enabling constant-time decoding and direct integration with GPU texture hardware. Choose it when hardware-accelerated decompression or fast random access to specific regions is required. [Value compression](6-value-compression.md)

### [Wavelet and Pyramid Transforms](3856-wavelet-and-pyramid-transforms.md)
Compresses data by decomposing $V$ into coefficients $C$ using linear transforms (wavelets/pyramids), supporting multi-resolution access via recursive hierarchy. Sets it apart from blockwise methods by typically applying the transform to the entire volume or large coherent blocks rather than independent small blocks, preserving global statistical properties. Choose it when multi-resolution rendering and efficient storage of smooth gradients are prioritized. [Wavelet and Pyramid Transforms](3856-wavelet-and-pyramid-transforms.md)

### [Blockwise Wavelet Compression](6100-blockwise-wavelet-compression.md)
Decomposes 3D data into small, equal-sized blocks to enable independent compression and parallel processing, localizing the transform. Sets it apart from global wavelet methods by facilitating parallel processing and localized detail extraction. Choose it when parallel processing and localized detail extraction are required. [Blockwise Wavelet Compression](6100-blockwise-wavelet-compression.md)
